title: Storm Witch Orb
description: A surreal female figure with glowing orange eyes and dark flowing hair emerges from a stormy landscape, holding a large iridescent crystal orb with both hands. Dark twisted roots and small fish-like creatures swirl around her as lightning cracks across purple and teal storm clouds above a rocky reflective shore.
prompt: A mystical woman with glowing orange eyes and pale blue skin holds a large translucent orb that glows with inner rainbow light, dark twisted roots and small fish swirl around her head and hands, dramatic lightning storm with purple and teal clouds fills the sky, rocky shoreline with reflective water, dark fantasy surreal style, cinematic lighting, highly detailed
